args.goal: Check for an equivalent Gumroad verdict and reuse the current SQLite hosted-checkout work, including any finding about differentiation from the free release. Read back the first-party Gumroad pricing and payout captures and inspect at most one additional official product eligibility source if necessary. Verify Canadian seller payout, relevant downloadable software terms and AI disclosure requirements. If an existing comparison found no distinct paid benefit and the package has not changed, reuse that finding and stop packaging across channels until a testable buyer benefit is identified. Otherwise, if the platform terms support the offer, run one clean-directory comparison demonstrating a specific paid benefit that the current free edition does not provide. Prepare private listing copy and one provisional net-proceeds calculation only if both gates pass. Record source passages, receipts, actual test results or the decisive gap, and a concrete reconsideration trigger under products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/. Read back the evidence before closing with the actual lease and a lesson. No account creation, external contact, spending or publication. Keep activation, sale, payout and verified settlement distinct. Preserve host-enforced independent review for any later public release.
